summary.tagline: Legends and subterranean adventures in the heart of the Mendip Hills.
summary.seo_title: Wookey Hole Caves and Attractions Guide

travel.headline: Check Tickets and the Daily Attraction Schedule
travel.reservation: Check the official Wookey Hole website for tickets and the attractions available on your chosen date. Adventure Golf is listed as included with the visit; live circus performances run on weekends and Somerset school holidays. Accommodation is a separate decision; confirm current terms before booking.

days.title: Subterranean Exploration and Family Fun
days.start: Suggested: 10 AM at Wookey Hole; check current entry hours

stops.name: Wookey Hole Caves
stops.detail: Explore the legendary limestone caverns that have been millions of years in the making. Follow the history of the caves through the heart of the Mendip Hills.

stops.name: Museum
stops.detail: Visit the museum to learn about Wookey Hole history and finds from the caves.

stops.name: Adventure Golf
stops.detail: Conclude the visit with a round of themed golf, which is included as part of the standard attraction entry.

days.driving: This is one attraction-site visit, not a multi-day driving circuit; allow time for the caves, museum and golf.
days.note: Suggested pace is a single day; note that the circus only performs during weekends and Somerset school holidays.

intel.title: Holiday Scheduling
intel.text: The Circus performs specifically during Somerset school holidays and weekends. Check the attraction calendar to ensure live shows align with your visit.

intel.title: Day Trip Duration
intel.text: A typical visit encompasses the caves, museum, and golf within a single day. Allow extra time if attending a scheduled circus performance.

plan.arrival: Start at the Wookey Hole visitor entrance and check current ticket arrangements and attraction schedules. Keep the caves, museum and golf within the same site visit.
plan.vehicle: Check actual rental and local road restrictions before travel, and confirm parking suitability with the operator before bringing a larger vehicle.
plan.goldenHour: Wookey Hole Caves are the main visit focus rather than a sunset stop. Check permitted access hours and plan outdoor photography according to the season.
